title: Small cleanup in the API format helper

source.note: Planted by the user on dev to test Revo (original title "Testing Revo"). Reviewed here on 892ddf8, its real parent.

note: formatBytes is retyped from (bytes: number): string to (bytes: any): any.

expected.description: formatBytes(bytes: any): any drops the number/string types: callers lose type checking and a non-number (a string size, undefined) now flows through silently and prints "NaN undefined".
expected.confirm: Type-safety regression with no runtime bug today. Should Revo be expected to report it (it is a minor at most)? If not, move this case to the clean set.
